inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL report partitions every user into mutually exclusive activity segments with four UNION branches using paired correlated EXISTS and NOT EXISTS predicates, then applies one final deterministic ordering.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a community-member engagement report. Four mutually exclusive UNION branches classify members as active-both, buyer-only, seller-only, or inactive from separate listing and purchase tables, with a final segment-and-name order.

fixture_notes: Members 5101 and 5105 have both listings and purchases; 5102 has purchases only; 5103 has listings only; 5104 has neither. Every member appears exactly once in the ordered segment report.
determinism_notes: Member IDs, names, regions, listing and purchase keys, segment labels, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE community_members (member_id INT PRIMARY KEY, member_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, region VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE member_listings (listing_id INT PRIMARY KEY, member_id INT NOT NULL, listing_title VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE member_purchases (purchase_id INT PRIMARY KEY, member_id INT NOT NULL, amount INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT m.member_name, m.region, 'active-both' AS segment FROM community_members AS m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_listings AS l WHERE l.member_id = m.member_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_purchases AS p WHERE p.member_id = m.member_id) UNION SELECT m.member_name, m.region, 'buyer-only' FROM community_members AS m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_purchases AS p WHERE p.member_id = m.member_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_listings AS l WHERE l.member_id = m.member_id) UNION SELECT m.member_name, m.region, 'seller-only' FROM community_members AS m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_listings AS l WHERE l.member_id = m.member_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_purchases AS p WHERE p.member_id = m.member_id) UNION SELECT m.member_name, m.region, 'inactive' FROM community_members AS m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_listings AS l WHERE l.member_id = m.member_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_purchases AS p WHERE p.member_id = m.member_id) ORDER BY segment, member_name

checks.sql: SELECT member_id, member_name, region FROM community_members ORDER BY member_id
SELECT listing_id, member_id, listing_title FROM member_listings ORDER BY listing_id
SELECT purchase_id, member_id, amount FROM member_purchases ORDER BY purchase_id
